name: Devourer of Souls
summary: In the Temple of the Damned, Carendin Halgar teaches Forsaken warlocks to bind a succubus. Godrick Farsan knows how to draw one from the Twisting Nether with the hearts of pure, loving mortals.

sections.title: Baiting the Nether
sections.body: Carendin Halgar teaches that a succubus must be lured across the threshold, not called by command. The demon hungers to ruin virtue and consume mortal essence. Offer the hearts of genuinely virtuous, loving men as bait. Halgar sends you to Godrick Farsan, who knows where such rare quarry can be found.

sections.title: The Blind Assistant
sections.body: Deep in the Temple of the Damned, Godrick Farsan helps Carendin prepare for demonic binding. Farsan has lost his physical sight, but says this has given him a deeper one. He claims to perceive spiritual currents and distant souls with uncanny clarity. With that sight, he can guide you to the pure hearts needed to draw out the demon.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: This step takes you from Carendin Halgar's summons to the hunt needed to bind a succubus. You go to Godrick Farsan, who explains the ritual's grim requirements.

faq.q: Why does a succubus need pure hearts to be summoned?
faq.answer: Carendin Halgar says a succubus needs an irresistible lure to cross into this world. The demon hungers to corrupt goodness, tempt mortal hearts, and devour virtuous souls, so the untainted devotion of good men draws it across.

Godrick Farsan is an undead warlock acolyte who assists Carendin Halgar in the Temple of the Damned. Though physically blind, his mystical senses help him perceive spiritual truths and locate suitable prey across the Eastern Kingdoms.
You complete this in the Temple of the Damned in the Undercity. Godrick Farsan waits just a few paces from Carendin Halgar.

faq.q: What comes after Devourer of Souls?
aliases: next quest after devourer of souls
faq.answer: Godrick Farsan next sends you to Hearts of the Pure. You travel to the Wetlands and the Greymane Wall in Silverpine Forest to claim the hearts of two virtuous mortals.

faq.q: Can any race undertake this ritual?
aliases: who can do devourer of souls
faq.answer: Any Horde warlock seeking to bind a succubus through Undercity mentors can follow Halgar and Farsan's ritual steps. Forsaken practitioners teach it in the Undercity, but the ritual is open to those warlocks.

angles.text: As a warlock, binding a succubus marks a major step in your training. You use a demon's vices and appetites to enslave it.
As an Undead, you train among Forsaken warlocks in the Temple of the Damned. They treat living purity and devotion as reagents for Nether rituals without moral restraint.
